CFML Language Reference: Functions

Reverse

Returns the string with its characters in reverse order.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Reverse(string)

Parameters

string
The string to reverse.

Returns

The reversed string.

Usage

To reverse a list rather than the characters of a string, loop over the list and use ListPrepend.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Words = "stressed,racecar,KoldFusion,1999">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>Reverse</TH><TH>Palindrome?</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Words#" INDEX="w">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#w#</TD><TD>#Reverse(w)#</TD>
<TD>#YesNoFormat(CompareNoCase(w, Reverse(w)) EQ 0)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

Compare, ListPrepend, Mid
